assertion: The share of banking system assets held by community banks has declined from 45 percent in the early 1990s to just 15 percent last year
reason: Recomputed 14.4% at 2025-12-31 (about 15 within rounding; 13.4% at mid-2026). The 1992 base of 45% is not in the warehouse and rests on the group's own FDIC BankFind analysis.
measure: community bank share of banking assets FDIC
sql: SELECT repdte, 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN total_assets_thousands<10000000 THEN total_assets_thousands ELSE 0 END)/SUM(total_assets_thousands) FROM banking.financials WHERE repdte IN (DATE '2025-12-31', DATE '2026-06-30') GROUP BY repdte
independent_value: Better Markets letter p.2: 45% (1992) to 13% (this year), citing FDIC BankFind

assertion: the share for large banks has increased from under 20 percent to over 70 percent
reason: Recomputed 69.9% at 2025-12-31 and 71.8% at 2026-06-30, so 'over 70' holds for the current period. Under-20% 1992 base not in warehouse.
sql: SELECT repdte, 100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN total_assets_thousands>100000000 THEN total_assets_thousands ELSE 0 END)/SUM(total_assets_thousands) FROM banking.financials WHERE repdte IN (DATE '2025-12-31', DATE '2026-06-30') GROUP BY repdte

assertion: The FDIC's proposal would make this dynamic much worse by including absurd provisions such as unsupported and unreasonable timelines that trigger automatic merger approvals and application acceptance.
reason: Proposal does set deemed-approved windows (as few as 5 business days for de minimis, 90/150-day standard windows) and deemed-substantially-complete status. Adjectives are characterization; the 'worse' effect is a prediction.
independent_value: Reed Smith, Skadden: deemed approval if FDIC misses windows
searched: FDIC proposed rule bank merger applications deemed approved timelines 2026

assertion: Such provisions can only serve one purpose: making bank mergers much easier and faster.
reason: Claim about motive and exclusivity of purpose, stated as belief; no evidence can test it.
searched: FDIC proposed rule bank merger applications deemed approved timelines 2026

assertion: the Main Street economy already is being disadvantaged by upside-down banking rules that are most supportive of the biggest banks that do the least amount of lending to Main Street
reason: Rests only on Better Markets' own analysis (large banks use 40-43% of deposits for real-economy lending vs about 75% for community banks) with its own definition; warehouse financials has no loan columns by size, and no independent source replicating it was found.
measure: bank lending to deposits by bank size
searched: bank size loans to deposits community banks large banks real economy lending

assertion: The bank merger review process has long had serious deficiencies, and now the FDIC is seeking to turn it into a rubber-stamp process
reason: Evaluative judgment and figurative 'rubber-stamp'; no evidence can test it.

assertion: FDIC Merger Rules Threaten Survival of Community Banks
source_finding: Letter attributes the share decline to the 1994 Riegle-Neal Act onward and calls the proposal a worsening factor; no survival-threat quantification.
reason: No estimate of the proposal's effect on community bank numbers or share was found; about 4,000 community banks exist (4,036 under $10B in the 2026-09-30 snapshot).
measure: community bank share of banking assets FDIC
sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN total_assets_thousands<10000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM banking.institutions WHERE active
searched: FDIC bank merger proposal effect on community banks
